lore_anchors.definition: A fully realized magical treasure that is an upgrade from a Talisman Treasure; far more difficult to activate but proportionally more powerful, it represents a Foundation Establishment cultivator’s ultimate trump card.
A forced, incomplete state where a cultivator becomes a crystalline predator, gaining enhanced defense and speed at the cost of human sensation and sanity.
A high-speed movement technique that blurs the user’s form, taxing the body even for a mid-Foundation Establishment cultivator.
